market.summary: India reopens today after Tuesday's Dussehra holiday and GIFT Nifty points to a gap-up of roughly 80-130 points. Overnight the US closed mixed (Dow up 1%, S&P 500 up 0.3%, Nasdaq flat), Japan is higher this morning, and the rupee is slightly firmer. Brent is still near $110 and FIIs were net sellers into the holiday, so the engine's RISK-OFF market check still applies even if the open is strong.
